areas.name: Abandoned Apartment
areas.description: Dust and termites consume the abandoned furniture. The former resident may still be present. Beware the Hollow — something that once lived here, now twisted into an undead husk.

areas.name: Apartment Hallway
areas.description: A narrow, lightless hallway stretches towards a stairwell. Somewhere in the darkness, a stranger cries for help. The voice sounds human, but something about it feels terribly wrong. Do you help the stranger?

areas.name: Stairwell
areas.description: Cracked concrete steps descend into absolute darkness. You cannot see what waits below, but something is moving in the blackness. A Lurker may be waiting to ambush anyone foolish enough to descend.

areas.name: Ground-Floor Exit
areas.description: A battered door leads out into the cold night air.
